integrity: The source date is the first arXiv posting date. The proof distinguishes the general interval-poset representation from the new three-dimensional coefficient evaluation and does not claim independent validation.
scientific_limitations: The theorem is restricted to face lattices of convex three-dimensional polytopes.
It does not settle gamma-positivity for arbitrary Gorenstein* lattices of rank four or higher.
The finite verifier checks consistency examples and algebraic reductions; the universal proof is the incidence-count argument.
title: Exact Z-polynomial for every three-dimensional convex polytope
